To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ITGB 3 polymorphism is not associated with breast or ovarian cancer in BRCA1 and/or BRCA2 mutation carrier.
the ITGB33 Leu33Pro variant was not associated with ovarian cancer in BRCA1/BRCA2 mutation carriers.
the ITGB33 polymorphism was found to be marginally associated with an increased breast and ovarian cancer risk for women with BRCA1 mutations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the ITGB3 (rs5918, Leu33Pro) polymorphism as a modifier in the risk of breast and ovarian cancer in BRCA1 and/or BRCA2 mutation positive women.
the identification of the genetic and environmental factors that modify the risk of breast and ovarian cancer in BRCA1 and/or BRCA2 mutation carrier women.
genetic factors that influence the development of breast and ovarian cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no evidence that the ITG3 Leu33pro polymorphism modifies the risk of ovarian cancer in BRCA1 mutation carries.
there is insufficient evidence that the ITG3B Leu33Pro variant modifies breast and/or ovarian cancer risk in carriers of BRCA1 or 2 mutations.
this polymorphism is unlikely to modify BRCA1 or 2 mutation carriers’ risks of breast and ovarian cancer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Leu33Pro ITGB3 polymorphisms does not seem to be a strong candidate modifier of BRCA1-associated ovarian cancer risk.
the ITGB 33LeuPro polymorphism does NOT modify breast cancer or ovarian cancer risks in BRCA1/BRCA2 mutation carriers.
there is no evidence of an interaction between BRCA1 and ITGB3 Le33Pro on ovarian cancer risk.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Leu33Pro ITGB3 polymorphic variant does not modify BRACA1/2-associated cancer risks.
the Leu33Pro variant does not modify the risk of breast or ovarian cancer in BRCA1/ BRCA2 mutation carries.
the ITGB-3 polymorphism is not a significant modifier of breast or ovarian cancer in BRCA mutation carriers.
